sections.title: The substrate: plan, reality, every stop with a reason
sections.alt: the filler guard closing as the line restarts, the panel with the stop list and one row highlighted

sections.title: What the substrate holds.
cols: Who this page is for — startups with a model or an agent for factories (optimisation, quality, energy, scheduling) and no plant floor of their own.
What SOP is — the substrate: plan, reality, every stop with a human's reason, work orders, energy and money, one security model, one command door.
The division of labour — we are your arms and legs; you bring the brain.
What it replaces — today the work is site by site.

sections.title: Data with provenance, a live stream
sections.alt: the server room behind glass: the open cabinet, the laptop on the steel cart, the console beyond
sections.promise: Plant data with provenance in one place, a live stream, and a safe, audited way to act on the plant.

sections.title: What a model needs, and where it already is.
cols: In one place — plan and reality, every stop with a human's reason, work orders, energy and money, on one database.
Provenance on every number — on every number in the batch record and in the OEE.
A plant with a history — the live cloud plant, with its history.
These are what can be shown today, on the running plant.

sections.title: One security model, one command door
sections.alt: a hand on the line panel's touch screen, an engineer beside it

sections.title: A safe, audited way to act on the plant.
cols: The audited command path — every command that reaches the plant goes through it, and it is audited.
A safe way to act — the third thing a model needs, beside the data and the stream.
A door for an agent, and for its data — built on the interfaces the platform already serves.
A plant to work against — a sandbox plant with months of history.
Read first, or write from day one — open, and settled in the conversation.

sections.title: Go to market together
sections.alt: four people around a laptop on a stainless table at the end of a packaging line

sections.title: Where it goes together.
cols: The decision we are after — build on SOP's data and agent door; go to market together.
Whose go-to-market — which industrial go-to-market is already yours; many models reach a plant through somebody else's.
The shape — open, and settled in the conversation.

sections.title: Write to us.
sections.alt: an engineer at an open cabinet noting the controllers on the line
sections.text: Start with one word so it reaches the right desk: DESKS. Tell us the country, what the line or machine produces, and which controllers are already on it. We reply from a person, never a queue.
